prompt: Run exactly one shell command, with the description "Pause a few seconds": sleep 8 && echo ok. Do not write any text before the tool call. After it finishes, write a short paragraph (at least 4 sentences) about three fun facts about lighthouses.

steps.until: (?m)^● Pause a few seconds · \d+s *\n +⎿ +\$ sleep 8 && echo ok \([3-9]s\)
